title: Birth in New Orleans and boyhood in Phoenix, Louisiana
summary: Born 1908 in New Orleans, lived in Phoenix, Louisiana until about 12; only guitar blues heard there.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: I was born 1908, uh, April the 22nd.
And where? In New Orleans. Exactly what street? Do you know?
Well, I think it was Boybin Street. Yeah. Near what? Near uh, St. Claude. Now Paul, though.
No, it was Boybin at that time. Yeah, but now Paul, though. It's Paul, but that's right. Now. So, uh, did you grow up here in the city?
Uh, well, uh, say from 12 years up. I was at Phoenix, Louisiana. Uh, at the age around of five years old up until 12 years old. Uh-huh. Uh-huh.
Do you remember anything, uh, before you were five of the city?
Well, no, not exactly. I was in and out, but I don't remember nothing particularly. Nothing about, uh, the music or anything you heard?
Not at that time. Yeah, too young.
About 12 years, and I knew it. Uh-huh, I see.
Well, what about your music out in Phoenix, Louisiana?
Well, I wasn't into, I mean, I was too young for that at that time. I got interested in it when I had to come back to the city.
Did you hear any music out there?
Well, no, I wouldn't see nothing but guitars, something like that.
Well, all the fellas. Mostly blues. Uh-huh.
Uh-huh. Do you remember any blues they played out there? Just the regular blues.
Twelve bar, eight bar, right? Or what?
Oh, something about a twelve bar, eight bar, something like that. Old standard blues.
Standard blues, that's all. I got the picture now. Yeah.
